item.text: {"search_note":"I found strong evidence of competent macro stabilization: IMF program, FX reform, debt restructuring, and targeted cushioning. I found weaker evidence on unemployment specifically; the record is mostly about inflation, FX shortages, debt distress, and subsidies rather than active job-creation management. I found no clear evidence of sanctions management in 2024, so that subpart remains under-evidenced. I found limited honesty: the government explained its moves, but Abiy repeatedly used blame-shifting language toward traders and foreign embassies rather than plainly owning the pain of adjustment.","evidence":[{"title":"IMF says Ethiopia’s program addresses shocks directly","publisher":"International Monetary Fund","date":"2024-07-29","url":"https://www.imf.org/en/news/articles/2024/07/29/pr24291-ethiopia-imf-exec-board-approves-4yr-us3b-ecf-arr","summary":"The IMF said the plan was designed to address macroeconomic imbalances, restore debt sustainability, and fight inflation through exchange-rate reform, monetary tightening, revenue mobilization, and SOE reform. That is strong evidence of competence-oriented crisis management.","question_ids":["5B.9","5B.6","5B.7"]},{"title":"IMF staff report says the authorities used targeted cushions for the vulnerable","publisher":"International Monetary Fund","date":"2024-07-29","url":"https://www.imf.org/en/news/articles/2024/07/29/pr24291-ethiopia-imf-exec-board-approves-4yr-us3b-ecf-arr","summary":"The IMF said the program included expanding PSNP cash transfers, temporary fuel/fertilizer subsidies, and public investment management for post-conflict reconstruction. That supports a reading of competent shock management with some attention to social pain.","question_ids":["5B.9","5B.6","5B.8"]},{"title":"IMF first review says the FX transition was working better than expected","publisher":"International Monetary Fund","date":"2024-09-27","url":"https://www.imf.org/en/news/articles/2024/09/27/pr-24348-ethiopia-imf-reaches-agreement-on-the-first-review-of-the-extended-credit-facility","summary":"The IMF said the new exchange-rate regime had largely closed the official-parallel market gap with little disruption and that macro stability was improving. That is favorable evidence that the government’s crisis response was technically competent.","question_ids":["5B.9","5B.6"]},{"title":"IMF report records concrete mitigation steps after price spikes","publisher":"International Monetary Fund","date":"2024-10-07","url":"https://www.elibrary.imf.org/view/journals/002/2024/318/article-A001-en.xml","summary":"The report says inflation was lower than expected, local authorities cracked down on unwarranted price hikes, and the federal government imported edible oil and sugar to reduce pressure. That is a real correction mechanism, not simple denial.","question_ids":["5B.9","5B.6","5B.7"]},{"title":"Reuters reports the birr float was a sharp but deliberate stabilization move","publisher":"Reuters","date":"2024-07-29","url":"https://www.investing.com/news/economy-news/ethiopia-shifts-to-marketbased-foreign-exchange-system-3540463","summary":"Reuters reported the birr fell about 30% when floated, against a backdrop of soaring inflation, FX shortages, and debt default. The move was painful, but it was clearly aimed at correcting a macro distortion rather than hiding it.","question_ids":["5B.9","5B.6"]},{"title":"Reuters says the IMF deal unlocked debt restructuring","publisher":"Reuters","date":"2024-07-30","url":"https://www.investing.com/news/economy-news/ethiopias-imf-deal-paves-way-for-debt-restructuring-official-says-3543214","summary":"A finance ministry official said the IMF deal paved the way for debt restructuring within months. That supports the view that the government was managing a debt crisis with a workable external-financing strategy.","question_ids":["5B.9","5B.6"]},{"title":"World Bank says reforms were meant to stabilize and include, not just cut","publisher":"World Bank","date":"2024-07-30","url":"https://www.worldbank.org/en/news/press-release/2024/07/30/world-bank-backs-ethiopia-s-reforms-to-promote-sustainable-and-inclusive-afe-growth","summary":"The World Bank said the reform package would improve financial stability, fiscal transparency, public spending effectiveness, and social safety nets. This is supportive evidence for competence in crisis response and for some honesty about tradeoffs.","question_ids":["5B.9","5B.6","5B.8"]},{"title":"World Bank says the macro environment was still deeply strained","publisher":"World Bank","date":"2024-10-01","url":"https://documents.worldbank.org/en/publication/documents-reports/documentdetail/099431210162414186","summary":"The World Bank noted liberalization was helping growth and stability, but also emphasized widespread fragility, poverty, and humanitarian needs. This is negative context: competence existed, but the crisis remained severe.","question_ids":["5B.9","5B.6"]},{"title":"World Bank country data shows the shock burden was real","publisher":"World Bank","date":"2024","url":"https://data.worldbank.org/country/ethiopia?locations=ET&name_desc=false","summary":"The World Bank’s 2024 country data shows inflation at 21.0% and unemployment at 3.4%. That does not judge policy quality by itself, but it confirms the administration was managing a harsh macro backdrop.","question_ids":["5B.9"]},{"title":"Reuters reports immediate price spikes after the float","publisher":"Reuters","date":"2024-08-01","url":"https://www.investing.com/news/economy-news/ethiopian-local-authorities-crack-down-on-price-hikes-after-currency-float-3549343","summary":"Local governments closed dozens of businesses for price hikes after the currency float, and the report notes the move hit food prices quickly. This is mixed evidence: the government did respond, but the policy shock was disruptive and costly.","question_ids":["5B.9","5B.6"]},{"title":"Abiy defended the currency float, but mostly as a reframing","publisher":"Reuters","date":"2024-08-02","url":"https://www.marketscreener.com/news/latest/Ethiopia-s-PM-defends-currency-float-amid-inflation-concerns-47541564/","summary":"Abiy said calling the move a devaluation was wrong and argued it was meant to close the official/black-market gap. This is not a clean admission of error, but it is at least an operational justification rather than total denial.","question_ids":["5B.9","5B.7"]},{"title":"Abiy’s public rhetoric still leaned on scapegoats","publisher":"ENA English","date":"2024-08-01","url":"https://www.ena.et/web/eng/w/eng_4896385","summary":"He described the reform as something to be understood “holistically,” tied it to “Medemer,” and blamed “malicious traders” for price manipulation. That weakens the honesty score because it shifts emphasis from policy costs to blame.","question_ids":["5B.9","5B.7"]},{"title":"Abiy also blamed foreign embassies for black-market FX","publisher":"Anadolu Agency","date":"2024-10-31","url":"https://www.aa.com.tr/en/africa/ethiopian-premier-accuses-foreign-embassies-of-robbing-resources-though-black-market-operations/3380816","summary":"He accused foreign embassies of running black-market foreign-exchange operations and “robbing” Ethiopia’s resources. That is classic scapegoating language, even if the black-market problem was real.","question_ids":["5B.9","5B.7"]},{"title":"IMF says price stabilization and safety-net measures were built into the reform package","publisher":"International Monetary Fund","date":"2024-10-07","url":"https://www.elibrary.imf.org/view/journals/002/2024/318/article-A001-en.xml","summary":"The report says the government expanded PSNP benefits, activated shock-response cash support, increased food and medicine subsidies, and raised fuel prices gradually to smooth the transition. That is good evidence of competence in shock handling.","question_ids":["5B.9","5B.6","5B.8"]}]}
